text:
Maya Patel: Quick design question — in the spend dashboard mock, do we want the little minimap (left rail) that shows time range + sparkline, or keep the toolbar top controls? Thinking scannability vs persistent context.
Kevin Tran: Toolbar for me. Minimap is clever but it hides scope unless expanded. Top controls easier to discover. :thinking_face:
Elena Rios: Accessibility concern: minimap contrast is low and it lacks ARIA. If we keep it we need aria-label and keyboard focus support.
Sam O'Neill: Minimap helps power users with brushing to select ranges, fewer clicks. Could be collapsed by default for new users.
Jordan Wu: Hybrid idea: toolbar for scope (Org / Project / Time), compact visual minimap under chart header (read-only), expanded minimap for interaction. Avoid keyboard traps in collapsed state.
Maya Patel: Two main decisions: 1) primary scope affordance — toolbar chip or left rail? 2) token breakdown & invoice CTA placement so it remains visible when scrolling charts.
Kevin Tran: Vote: toolbar chips for scope; pin token breakdown as a compact card in the right column with totals + CTA; invoice download as persistent header action (top-right).
Elena Rios: Accessibility checklist: ensure pinned token card has proper headings; invoice button uses aria-haspopup="dialog" if modal; fix color contrast on token delta badges (current mock fails AA at small sizes).
Sam O'Neill: Copy nit: label "Tokens used" is ambiguous for multi-model orgs. Suggest "Total tokens (all models)" and expand-by-model in rows.
Jordan Wu: Responsive layout: toolbar (scope + time) at top, chart area with compact minimap beneath header, right column: token breakdown + invoice CTA + quick links (API keys, billing settings). Mobile: right column collapses into accordion below the chart.
Maya Patel: OK. Next steps: Elena to run contrast and keyboard audit; Sam to propose updated copy; Jordan to upload responsive mocks; Kevin to run 3 quick usability sessions tomorrow.
designbot: Reminder: design review Thu 2pm. Upload updated Figma frames by Wed EOD.
Elena Rios: Noted. I'll add aria-labels and test tab order for the minimap expanded state.
Kevin Tran: Recruiting 3 folks for 15-min hallway tests tomorrow 10:30am to focus on scope switching and invoice flow.
Maya Patel: If we agree hybrid I'll update the PR with header CTA pattern and pin behavior. :thumbsup:
